description.value: A Mosaic Forest Management campsite beside Macktush Creek in central Vancouver Island's working forest; expect gravel logging-road access and basic or no facilities, with no confirmed drinking water.

address.value: 12951 Canal Main, A, BC V0R 2B0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active, real campsite on Mosaic Forest Management land, operated by Silvifor Resource Consultants Ltd., with a 2026 season (April 17–September 22) and an online booking interface, supporting confirmed_open=true and reservations_accepted=true. The site description mentions walking trails, a boat launch, and that tents/motorhomes/trailers/fifth wheels are permitted, but provides no detail on facilities such as toilets, water, or showers. No phone number or physical address appears in OSM or on the website.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM or on the website.

No physical/civic address in OSM; campsite is accessed via Canal Main Resource Road approximately 32 km from Port Alberni on a forest service road (~1 hour drive), which may present challenges for road cyclists.
A designated area of the campsite is occupied by seasonal campers, which may limit availability for passing tourers.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable campsite with an operational 2026 season. Useful to touring cyclists seeking overnight accommodation on the Alberni Inlet.
enrichment_extras.notes: Firewood may be available for sale when campfires are permitted; check with host on arrival. Contact email for off-season inquiries is campsites@silvifor.com (from the off-season booking subpage).

wow_evidence: basic or no facilities, with no confirmed drinking water
